//: Type-checking only — no .ts files, nothing is compiled or emitted. The app stays plain JS (see package.json). checkJs is deliberately OFF here: turning it on globally would type-check all 36 files in one shot and surface a wall of pre-existing errors. Instead, add a `// @ts-check` comment at the top of a file to opt that file in individually — see core/api.js for the first one (kept as its own small file separate from core/utils.js's untyped DOM helpers, specifically so @ts-check's whole-file scope doesn't drag in unrelated code). Widen `include` file-by-file as more files get JSDoc types, rather than flipping checkJs on for everything at once.
